headline: Budget context, Act 170 merger timeline, Spark Center and HVAC update, and student policies.
summary: The meeting will cover budget context and the Act 170 merger timeline. It will also include a Spark Center and HVAC update, policy adoption and a first reading of a new policy, and an executive session on the superintendent evaluation.
